Title: Quick Sort
Description: A highly efficient sorting algorithm and is based on partitioning of array of data into smaller arrays.
Explanation:
Quick Sort is a Divide and Conquer algorithm. It picks an element as 'pivot' and partitions the given array around the picked pivot.

**Algorithm:**
1. Pick a pivot (often the last element).
2. Partition the array so elements smaller than pivot move left, larger move right.
3. Recursively apply to the left and right halves.
